guidedReferences.name: +Grenade / -Melee
guidedReferences.note: We generally don't attach tooltips to mods that go in the first slot of armour pieces or into an artifice mod slot. The Compendium approaches it the same way so these kinds of mods will not be found there. All that needs to be known about these mods is provided by the API (usually investmentStat property that partner apps simply display).

guidedReferences.name: Precise Jolts
guidedReferences.note: Small typos in the Compendium should not lead to an inability to match.

guidedReferences.name: Impact, Shock, Gravity
guidedReferences.note: This is an artifact perk that has been sunset (its match is in an OLD sheet). Only the current artifact sheet's perks should get matched.

guidedReferences.name: Elemental Siphon
guidedReferences.note: There are two perks with this name in the artifact sheet under two different artifacts. You should have a way to distinguish between which artifact a perk belongs to and search in the sheet based on that.

guidedReferences.note: Most perks in the first two columns of weapon perks do not need a description as their behaviour is entirely explained by the API-providex investmentStat info.
